items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I used to hear Manuel's band most of the times. He seemed to have been the favorite band leader for these funeral parades and whatnot.

ctx.x: No, there was no real clarinet but it was a kazoo made in the shape of a clarinet. Oh I see. And then too I used to alternate from the clarinet to the bass drum, because I used to like to beat the bass drums. And one particular fella around there at that time, I used to call him, I don't remember his name, but you could hear him beat that bass drum miles and miles off and I was more or less inspired there too. And of course this was during the time that when Manuel Perez had his great band. I don't know whether…
I met him once in 1943. Oh you did?
